digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify gate and External Integration workflow
propositions: Complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every Gerrit Verify cell contributes measured 184.32-second macOS overhead; implementation must reduce per-change subprocess work while retaining all assertions and complete real-Pandoc replay capability.

Broad corpus assertions must consume committed deterministic Pandoc outputs covering all 178 bodies and 1,383 ordered conversions; three evidence-selected real product-path bodies per stratum (code_arrow, table, prose) must remain in Gerrit Verify hot path.
Committed fixtures must cover Pandoc 3.6.1 with frozen Linux x86_64 and Darwin arm64 binary SHA-256 values; fixture generation and non-writing validation must be deterministic and explicit.
External Integration Tests must add a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job running full replay on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms via weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch.

All existing corpus assertion classes, supported Python cells, and supported operating-system cells must remain present in Gerrit Verify; no behavioral assertion, contractual assertion, or dependency removal is permitted.
